description: Questions the TPC-DS store-sales star of helios init --sample can answer.

questions.question: What is total store sales revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: How many units did the stores sell in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantity FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is total store sales profit?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is the store sales profit margin?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) / SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_profit_margin FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: Show store sales revenue by state.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s_state, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_state

questions.question: What was store sales revenue in each year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d_year, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY d_year

questions.question: Which item categories earn the most store sales profit?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT i_category, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_category

questions.question: What is the store sales profit margin of each item category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT i_category, SUM(ss_net_profit) / SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_profit_margin FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_category

questions.question: Show store sales revenue by the upper bound of the customer household's income band.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk JOIN tpcds.income_band ON hd_income_band_sk = ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ib_upper_bound

questions.question: How much did customers save with coupons, by gender?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT cd_gender, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS store_sales_coupon_amount FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd_gender
